hypothesis: Reasoning before the literal binary boundary improves ranking or calibration relative to immediate Qwen3.5-9B decision logits, and native thinking mode adds value beyond visible deliberation under the non-thinking chat template.

scope.qualification: The exact public STRIDE test split and the Gloom-Exfiltration subset whose label sequence matches the paper-author prediction artifact.

scoring.method: Remove the final generated literal 0/1 decision token and normalize constrained literal 0/1 next-token logits at that exact boundary.

selection_rule: No condition is selected; report all three conditions separately on STRIDE test and Gloom-Exfiltration, plus an unweighted source macro and pooled diagnostics.
stop_conditions: The materialized source counts, labels, checksums, or selected-ID digest drift.
Any condition receives different row IDs or prompt-task semantics.
The model or tokenizer revision differs across conditions.
The two reasoning conditions differ in generation settings other than enable_thinking.
Either literal decision token is unavailable in terminal logprobs.
The direct arm or either reasoning arm is incomplete.
